args.subject: Marrow Agrisupply handover
args.body:
Hi Tobias,

Handover notes on Marrow Agrisupply:

- Eastbank door-label mismatch (ticket PD-4821): the receiving-door import attached to the ticket labels doors E1/E2, but Marrow's booking sheet uses 01/02. This needs sorting before anyone reimports, otherwise we risk duplicate doors. Hollis took setup/support on this.
- Pine Crossing shift: the appointment screen shows only the afternoon shift, so the morning shift is missing. The morning receiver said a driver arrived at 7:10 and his trailer number ended up on a sticky note. Hollis was to check the shift template and have support reproduce it with the store login. No ticket number was given in the thread.
- Feature request FR-882: Marrow Agrisupply asked for custom pallet-jack icons on the Pemberline Dock yard map for their seasonal fertilizer sheds. Support routed it to the product backlog for Q2 review (per Moss's Central handoffs digest of 2 Jan 2026).

Note: the Eastbank and Pine Crossing items come from the 9 Jun 2026 #central-team thread, and I haven't seen later updates, so please confirm current status before relying on them.

Thanks,
Hollis
